platform.codebase: Single shared codebase; separate public/internal deployments

coding_rules.dependency_injection: Constructor injection with @inject, auto-discovery, no unnecessary manual registration
coding_rules.session_lifecycle: Never share AsyncSession across requests; use scoped sessions
coding_rules.migration: Versioned Alembic migration; model registered in metadata

modules.name: http_application
modules.responsibility: Thin FastAPI controllers, DTOs, route discovery and HTTP authorization mapping

modules.name: chat_and_conversation
modules.responsibility: Orchestrate conversations and grounded responses without SQL/HTTP concerns

modules.name: knowledge_ingestion
modules.responsibility: Lifecycle, document versioning, chunking and approval workflows

modules.name: retrieval_answer
modules.responsibility: Persian normalization, hybrid retrieval strategy, reranking, citation and abstention

modules.name: religious_qa
modules.responsibility: Approved religious sources, disagreement and expert referral

modules.name: hr_matching
modules.responsibility: HR matching proposals, eligibility and human review; no auto personnel changes

modules.name: hr_transfer
modules.responsibility: Policy-constrained transfer proposals; execution only with approval

modules.name: research
modules.responsibility: Evidence-rich comparison of prior organizational experiences

modules.name: task_allocation
modules.responsibility: Draft task breakdown and approval-governed allocation

modules.name: repositories
modules.responsibility: SQLAlchemy models/queries via PsqlDbContext and BaseRepository

modules.name: qdrant_provider
modules.responsibility: Actual Qdrant I/O and index lifecycle later; no phase 01 client

modules.name: model_providers
modules.responsibility: Self-hosted LLM, embeddings and reranker I/O later

modules.name: agent_provider
modules.responsibility: Future secured external Agent boundary; no implementation/API assumed

data_contract.postgresql_role: Authoritative publication, access, document versions, conversations, consent and audits
data_contract.qdrant_role: Rebuildable scope-filtered retrieval index, never authoritative for publication/authz
data_contract.versioning: Immutable identity and checksum per approved document version; references map to canonical chunk and source span
data_contract.revocation: PostgreSQL revoke commits before Qdrant cleanup; every candidate must pass latest publication and ACL validation
data_contract.consistency: Manifest/reconciliation and retryable index update; fail closed on metadata unavailability
data_contract.note: Logical entities only; no SQL migration or final schema approved

security.authorization: Authenticate, then RBAC/ABAC before search and reauthorize candidates before response
security.public_internal: No direct Public path to Internal HR, PostgreSQL, Qdrant, Agent or private inference
security.human_review: Mandatory for personnel-impacting actions and task execution

rag_pipeline: dense and sparse/lexical retrieval with scope filter

agent_owns: destination interactions under its own authorization
agent_integration.note: No endpoint, transport or Agent implementation has been provided or verified
